report_name: IBM & Red Hat's "Lightwell" Initiative Fixes 400+ Java Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.name: Over 400 Java Library Vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.description: A collection of over 400 previously unknown vulnerabilities in widely used open-source Java libraries, identified and remediated by the Lightwell initiative.

identities.name: IBM
identities.description: Co-leader of the Lightwell initiative, a project to proactively find and fix vulnerabilities in open-source software.

identities.name: Red Hat
identities.description: Co-leader of the Lightwell initiative, a project to proactively find and fix vulnerabilities in open-source software.

identities.name: Lightwell initiative
identities.description: A joint project by IBM and Red Hat that has identified and remediated over 400 vulnerabilities in open-source Java libraries. The initiative includes the Lightwell Clearinghouse service for prioritized security analysis and backported patches.
